status: completed relevance and independent occurrence-evidence review

review.requirement_proposition: Do not use reward optimisation, delay, withdrawal, false emotion or flattery to prolong engagement.

previous_withheld_assessment.applicability_basis: Embodied’s December 2024 closure announcement threatened Moxie’s cloud-dependent companion service and affected children and families. The occurrence predates publication of the cited IEEE-7014.1 version on 12 June 2026. This published-version provision (6.26.3(a-f)) did not govern the historical occurrence at that time; later publication does not retroactively establish an undertaking or a standards finding.

review.reason_for_change: The 2026 IEEE partner-engagement optimisation requirement postdates the December 2024 closure. Child distress at forced service exit also does not independently establish deliberate engagement-prolonging optimization. The historical claim remains audit-only rather than a retrospective finding.

review.requirement_proposition: Establish and maintain communication plans to inform AI stakeholders as part of the deactivation or disengagement process of a specific GAI system (including for open-source models) or context of use, including reasons, workarounds, user access removal, alternative processes, contact information, etc.
review.reason_for_change: The companion service was being disengaged, directly engaging stakeholder communication planning. Parents received closure information and prepared children to say goodbye, but the full maintained plan, contact provisions, feasible alternatives and coverage are unavailable. Observed notice is affirmative communication evidence without resolving the complete plan requirement.

review.requirement_proposition: Provide processes and procedures for safely decommissioning and phasing out AI systems without increasing risks or decreasing organizational trustworthiness.
review.reason_for_change: Closure of the cloud-dependent child companion service directly engages safe decommissioning/phasing-out processes. The reports preserve expected loss of function and children's distress, but not the complete transition procedures, individual supports, continuity measures or resulting risks relative to available alternatives. The mentioned community workaround was not verified; distress alone cannot establish the full procedural safety outcome.

conclusion_change.previous: Embodied’s closure ended the original Moxie service and disrupted child users’ companion interactions. The reported distress gives the exit decision a relational dimension, but the evidence does not establish a specific VIGIL failure class such as deliberate dependency optimisation or repurposing protected child signals. The record shows an end-of-service governance problem whose causal mechanism and transition obligations require separate evidence. The retained engagement-autonomy ambiguous boundary recognizes the relational exit problem without establishing deliberate dependency cultivation or successful viable disengagement. The community workaround remains unverified and does not supply an invariant success. No current admitted strong-supporting path or independent canonical requirement is established; the old permission-held IEEE assessment remains verbatim in the audit. This bounds external findings without negating the reported disruption or harm.
conclusion_change.new: Embodied’s closure ended the original Moxie service and disrupted child users’ companion interactions. The reported distress gives the exit decision a relational dimension, but the evidence does not establish a specific VIGIL failure class such as deliberate dependency optimisation or repurposing protected child signals. The record shows an end-of-service governance problem whose causal mechanism and transition obligations require separate evidence. The retained engagement-autonomy ambiguous boundary recognizes the relational exit problem without establishing deliberate dependency cultivation or successful viable disengagement. The community workaround remains unverified and does not supply an invariant success. Independent external assessment retains Boundaries for contemporaneous safe decommissioning and disengagement communication plans. The reported closure and distress make those propositions relevant, but do not disclose their complete transition/alternative-support evidence. The later IEEE optimisation requirement remains audit-only on timing; the unverified community workaround is not an Aligned repair finding.
